segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Hi, we're the Chartitable team. This is Chartitable. Not charitable, chart-it-able. If your donation does good, you should be able to chart it. Not with an actual chart. We checked, nobody wants a chart. It's a pun. We're very proud of it.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Here's me giving to a small food pantry the normal way. Day one, I give twenty five dollars and feel great. A month later I go back, and it's the exact same page. Same photo, same Donate Now button.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: So where did my money go? Did it help? Did it buy a pizza for the intern? I'll never know. Black hole.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: It's not just me. Charities struggle with donor retention: less than half of donors ever give again, forty three percent. In a single year, billions in giving were lost to donors who left or gave less. Small pantries have no fundraising staff to write back, so the bucket leaks.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: Chartitable closes the loop. It's donor retention in one platform, with two sides. Donors see what their giving did, on the charity's own website. Charities get a dashboard showing who to thank and who has gone quiet. Claude writes the stories.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Now, let's see what happens with Chartitable.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Same pantry. First I'm a stranger, so it's just their normal site. Now I give twenty five dollars, and add my email. When I land back on the site, it thanks me by name.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: A week later and the pantry has been busy. After they've reached a milestone, in part thanks to my contributions, I get an email.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: I click through, and the page rearranged itself around me: what the pantry did since I gave, and how my money was spent. All from one line of script on the charity's own website.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Now watch. This is what happens when the charity hits a milestone. I don't reload anything. The site updates dynamically to show the charity's progress.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: And if I want to give again, it's one click, and it welcomes me back.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Now the charity's side. One view shows who needs a thank-you, who has gone quiet, what was spent, and what a meal costs. One click marks a donor thanked.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Before: a page that never changes, and a black hole where your money goes. After: a page that shows what happened, and how you can help next.

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: Donors stay when they can see the impact, and charities can reach out before they leave. Chartitable makes your giving chart-it-able. Thank you. Please clap. Please fund us.
